blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generalized panorama depth estimation has witnessed great advances in recent years. These methods typically achieve robust zero-shot generalization performance using large pretrained models, but their high computational cost makes real-time inference on embedded platforms challenging. In contrast, previous lightweight panorama models have mostly been developed for single-domain evaluations and cannot generalize well due to domain shifts. To reduce the gap between these two types of models, we introduce EG360, an efficient and generalizable panorama depth estimation model. Specifically, building on a lightweight depth model, we design an Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation (APPD) strategy guided by scene geometry, along with a Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF) module for global semantic perception. As a result, with only 6.593M parameters after reparameterization, EG360 achieves strong zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks and runs at 35 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode, whereas a previous ViT-small model runs at less than 2 FPS. Our code will also be made public for future research.
blocks.zh: 总体全景深度估计近年来取得了巨大进展。 这些方法通常使用经过预先训练的大型模型实现强力的零射一般化性能,但其高昂的计算成本使得对嵌入式平台的实时推论具有挑战性. 相比之下,之前的轻量级全景模型大多是为单域评价而开发的,由于域位变化而无法很好地概括. 为了缩小这两类模型之间的差距,我们引入了EG360,一种高效和可概括的全景深度估计模型. 具体来说,在轻量级深度模型的基础上,我们设计了以场景几何为指南的适应性全景-透视偏振(APPD)策略,同时设计了用于全球语义感知的球形跨层特性聚合(SCFF)模块. 因此,在经过重新参数化后,只有6.593M参数,EG360在现实世界基准上实现了强零镜头性能,并以35FPS运行在MAXN模式的Jetson Orin NX 16GB上,而之前的VIT-小型号运行在2FPS以下. 我们的代码也将公布于众,供将来研究.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, there has been a wide range of work that addresses challenges in processing panoramic images for various computer vision tasks, including depth estimation [ 23 , 17 , 5 ] , segmentation [ 58 , 55 , 60 ] , and tracking [ 16 , 25 , 50 ] . Among these, monocular panorama depth estimation is an important task that infers the 3D geometry of the corresponding scene from a 360 degree image, which can be useful for other applications such as virtual reality [ 3 , 44 ] and autonomous driving [ 38 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 近年来,为解决各种计算机视觉任务全景图像处理方面的挑战,开展了广泛的工作,包括深度估计[23、17、5]、分化[58、55、60]和跟踪[16、25、50]。 其中,单相光全景深度估计是从360度图像推断出相应场景的3D几何学的重要任务,对于虚拟现实[3,44]和自主驱动[38,30]等其它应用都可能有用.

blocks.en: In the domain of monocular panorama depth estimation, some generalizable methods [ 46 , 23 ] that can perform robust zero-shot predictions have emerged. Though they can achieve good performance, they tend to be based on large foundation models [ 28 , 13 ] , which are hard to meet real-time requirements on mobile platforms, e.g., Jetson Orin NX, an embedded AI computing platform for robotics. As shown in Fig. 1 , the DAP [ 23 ] model, which is built on top of a ViT-Large model [ 34 , 13 ] , obtains an average AbsRel of 0.135 on Matterport3D [ 7 ] , Stanford2D3D [ 2 ] and Metropolis [ 26 ] . However, it can only run at 0.54 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode. In contrast, previous lightweight models [ 42 , 17 , 62 ] focus on training and testing within the same domain and show limited cross-domain generalization performance. As shown in Fig. 1 , UniFuse [ 17 ] achieves only an average AbsRel of 0.229 and runs at 11 FPS. Thus, current panorama depth estimation models fail to deliver depth estimation results with a plausible trade-off between quality and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 在单体全景深度估计领域,出现了一些能够进行强力零发预测的通俗方法[46,23]. 虽然他们可以实现良好的性能,但往往基于大型的基础模型[28,13],这些模型在移动平台上难以满足实时要求,例如Jetson Orin NX,机器人的嵌入式AI计算平台. 如图1所示,DAP[23]型号以ViT-Large型号[34,13]为顶部,在Matterport3D上平均获得0.135 AbsRel. blocks.en: We argue that to achieve both efficiency and generalization, exposing the model to more real-world data via distillation and allowing it to capture semantic information efficiently are necessary. Concretely, we propose an Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation (APPD) strategy to exploit panorama and perspective teachers jointly. Whereas Depth Anywhere [ 45 ] and PanDA [ 6 ] rely on perspective and panoramic teachers, respectively, we combine their complementary supervision. Table 2 shows that DAP [ 23 ] performs better on Stanford2D3D, which is indoor, while MoGe2 [ 47 ] outperforms on Metropolis, which is outdoor. Their relative usefulness may also vary across views: a perspective crop dominated by a wall may provide limited cues for estimating absolute distance, whereas a panorama teacher can use the surrounding contexts. Motivated by this, APPD uses the proposed normalized plane-fitting residuals to dynamically adaptively weigh the two teacher losses, assigning more weight to the panorama teacher for more planar views. Additionally, to aggregate global contexts while accounting for spherical geometry, we introduce Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF). SCFF uses cross-level attention [ 40 ] between the two coarsest encoder feature maps, with the finer map querying the coarser one. Attention combines feature similarity with a spherical direction bias that reflects the spatial proximity on the sphere.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,为了实现效率和概括化,有必要通过蒸馏使模型接触到更真实的数据,并使其能够有效地获取语义信息。 具体地说,我们提出了一个适应性全景-透视分级(APPD)战略,共同利用全景和透视教师。 深度的任何地方[45]和PanDA[6]分别依靠视角和全景教师,而我们结合了他们的补充监督. 表2显示,DAP[23]在位于室内的斯坦福2D3D上表现较好,而MOGe2[47]在位于室外的大都会上表现优于. 它们相对有用性也可能因不同观点而异:以墙为主的视角作物可能为估计绝对距离提供有限的提示,而全景教师则可以利用周围环境。 以此为动机,APPD利用拟议中的平面相适应残基来动态地适应地权衡两个教师的损失,给全景教师分配了更多的分量,以获得更多的平面观. 此外,为了综合全球背景,同时计算出球形几何,我们引入了球形跨级地物融合(SCFF). SCFF在两个相近的编码器特征图之间使用跨相位关注[40],更细的地图查询相近的一. 注意结合了特征相似性与球形方向偏差,反映了球体的空间相近性.

blocks.en: Combining these two proposed techniques, we present EG360, a lightweight monocular panorama depth estimation model that can perform robust zero-shot predictions. Training on abundant labeled data [ 59 , 48 , 36 ] together with unlabeled data [ 9 , 61 ] , EG360, comprising 6.593M parameters and costing 23.492 GFLOPs after structural reparameterization [ 12 ] , can achieve an average AbsRel of 0.168 and run on Orin NX at 35 FPS. It not only runs faster than previous lightweight models but also narrows the gap between lightweight and foundation models.
blocks.zh: 结合这两项拟议技术,我们提出了EG360,一种轻量级单光谱深度估计模型,可以进行强力零发预测. 关于大量被贴上标签的数据的培训[59,48,36],加上未贴上标签的数据[9,61],EG360,包含6.593M参数,在结构再调整后成本为23.492 GFLOP[12],可以实现平均AbsRel为0.168并运行于Orin NX上35 FPS. 它不仅运行速度快于之前的轻量级模型,而且还缩小了轻量级模型和基础型模型之间的差距.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We propose Adaptive Panorama–Perspective Distillation (APPD), which uses normalized plane-fitting residuals to weigh panorama and perspective teacher supervision for unlabeled data adaptively. • We introduce Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF), which combines cross-level attention with a spherical direction bias to aggregate global context between the two coarsest feature maps. • We develop EG360, a lightweight model with 6.593M parameters and 23.492 GFLOPs, and demonstrate its zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 In-Domain Panorama Depth Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1 域内全景深度估计

blocks.en: Depth estimation for panorama images presents unique challenges due to the equirectangular projection (ERP) and resulting distortions. Some works directly work on the ERP image and propose different techniques to tackle the distortion. OmniDepth [ 63 ] uses both rectangular and square CNN filters. ACDNet [ 62 ] combines convolution kernels with different dilations with adaptive channel-wise fusions. PanoFormer [ 33 ] and EGFormer [ 54 ] propose panorama-specific transformer blocks to adapt widely used transformer [ 40 ] blocks to the panorama domain. Some other works use additional distortion-free formats for 360 images to mitigate the negative effects of distortions. BiFuse [ 42 ] , BiFuse++ [ 43 ] , and UniFuse [ 17 ] use cubemap (CP) images and fuse the features from CP and ERP images adaptively for better performance than using ERP or CP alone. HRDFuse [ 1 ] enhances depth prediction by collaboratively learning from ERP and tangent projections. In addition, S 2 S^{2} Net [ 21 ] moves to the spherical surface generated from the ERP image with the HEALPix sampling [ 14 ] . Nevertheless, these methods are typically trained and evaluated within the same domain, limiting their generalizability.
blocks.zh: 对全景图像的深度估计,由于等角投影(ERP)以及由此产生的扭曲,提出了独特的挑战. 有些直接研究ERP图像,并提出不同技术来解决扭曲问题。 Omni Depth [63] 既使用长方形又使用正方形的CNN滤波器. ACDNet [62]结合了不同拓扑的演化内核与适应性能的信道相通聚变. PanoFormer [33]和EGFormer [54] 提出全景特异变压器区块,使被广泛使用的变压器[40]区块适应全景域. 其他一些作品为360个图像使用了额外的无扭曲格式来减轻扭曲的负面影响. BiFuse [42],BiFuse++ [43],和UniFuse [17] 使用立方体(CP)图像,并适应性地将CP和ERP图像的特性引信,以便比仅使用ERP或CP更好性能. HRDFuse [1]通过合作从企业资源规划系统和准确预测中学习来增强深度预测。 此外,S2 S^{2}网 [21] 移动到由ERP图像所生成的球面上,用HEALPix取样[14]. 然而,这些方法通常都是在同一领域进行训练和评估的,限制了其普遍性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Zero-Shot Panorama Depth Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.2 零同步全景深度估计

blocks.en: Different from in-domain methods, zero-shot methods aim to perform robust predictions on unseen data. Depth AnyWhere [ 45 ] distills the knowledge from large perspective models [ 52 ] to small panorama models via unlabeled panorama data, while PanDA [ 6 ] distills from large panorama models. DA360 [ 18 ] finetunes Depth Anything V2 [ 53 ] and equips the DPT [ 31 ] decoder with ERP padding. DA 2 [ 20 ] generates high-quality panoramic depth data from perspective data via perspective-to-panorama diffusion [ 37 ] . DAP [ 23 ] introduces a three-stage curation pipeline to generate reliable pseudo labels for unlabeled images. DepthMaster [ 46 ] and PaGeR [ 5 ] utilize a Depth Anything V3 [ 22 ] structure to process cubemap images and produce ERP depth images. However, these zero-shot methods with large backbones tend to be computationally expensive, making them unsuitable for deployment on mobile platforms. Thus, we aim to develop a lightweight model by distilling complementary knowledge from panoramic and perspective teachers adaptively and enabling efficient spherical global context modeling.
blocks.zh: 与域内方法不同,零镜头方法旨在对看不见的数据进行强力预测. 深度AnyWhere[45]通过无标签的全景数据从大视角模型[52]向小全景模型分馏知识,而Panda[6]从大全景模型分馏知识. DA360 [18] 微调深度 Anything V2 [53],并装备了DPT [31] 解码器以ERP编解码. 数据 2 [20]通过视角到视角传播从视角数据生成高质量的全景深度数据[37]. DAP [23] 引入了三相校正管来为无标签图像生成可靠的伪标签. 深度master [46]和PaGeR [5]使用深度Anything V3 [22]结构来处理立方体图像并生成ERP深度图像. 然而,这些有大型骨干结构的"零射"方法往往在计算上很昂贵,因此不适合被部署在移动平台上. 因此,我们的目标是开发一个轻量级模型,从全景和视角教师中以适应性方式提炼补充知识,并促成高效的球面全球环境模型。

blocks.en: 2.3 Zero-Shot Perspective Depth Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.3 零热视角深度估计

blocks.en:
Recent advances in monocular depth estimation from perspective
images have benefited from improved architectures and increasingly diverse training data. MiDaS [ 32 ] enables joint learning from heterogeneous datasets using a robust, scale-shift-invariant loss. Depth Anything [ 52 ] and Depth Anything V2 [ 53 ] leverage large-scale unlabeled images to improve generalization. Beyond relative depth estimation, MoGe2 [ 47 ] recovers metric-scale 3D point maps from single images using a decoupled design that separates relative geometry and metric-scale learning. Despite their strong generalization capabilities, their computation costs make them unfriendly to mobile platforms. To improve deployment efficiency, FastDepth [ 49 ] combines a compact encoder-decoder architecture with network pruning for embedded inference. More recently, ZipDepth [ 39 ] enables efficient zero-shot depth estimation with large-scale knowledge distillation from a depth foundation model. However, these approaches are designed for perspective images and cannot be applied directly to panorama images.
blocks.zh:
从角度对单一深度估计的最新进展
图像得益于结构的改善和日益多样化的培训数据。 MiDAS [32] 能够利用强力的、规模变化-变化不定的损失,从各种数据集中联合学习。 深度 Anything [52]和深度 Anything V2 [53] 利用大规模无标签图像来改进通俗化. 在相对深度估计之外,MoGe2[47]利用将相对几何学和公尺尺度学分开的脱钩设计,从单个图像中恢复出公尺尺度的三维点图. 尽管具有很强的通俗化能力,但其计算成本使其对移动平台不友好. 为了提高部署效率,快深度[49]结合了紧凑的编码器-解码器架构和网络推想来进行嵌入推论. 最近,Zip Depth [39] 能够通过从深度地基模型中进行大规模的知识分馏,高效率地进行零射深度估计。 然而,这些方法是为视角图像而设计的,不能直接应用于全景图像.

blocks.en: We first finetune the base variant of ZipDepth [ 39 ] as our baseline since it has shown great accuracy-efficiency trade-offs in perspective depth estimation. Specifically, we initialize the model from the released official ZipDepth checkpoint and optimize metric inverse-depth objectives on labeled panorama data. Building on this baseline, we introduce APPD and SCFF to enhance its generalization to unseen data, resulting in our new model, EG360.
blocks.zh: 我们首先微调了Zip Depth [39] 的基础变体作为我们的基线,因为它在视角深度估计中表现出了极高的精度效率取舍. 具体地说,我们从发布的官方Zip Depth检查点初始化了这个模型,并优化了标注全景数据的平面反向深度目标. 在这个基线的基础上,我们引入了APPD和SCFF,以加强其通俗化到看不见的数据,从而形成了我们的新模型EG360.

blocks.en:
Different from previous perspective-teacher-only [ 45 ] or panorama-teacher-only [ 6 ] distillation, we design a joint
panorama-perspective distillation mechanism to combine the power from both worlds. To this end, we first verify that they are complementary across indoor and outdoor scenarios. Concretely, we evaluate the performance of the panoramic teacher DAP [ 23 ] and the
perspective teacher MoGe2 [ 47 ] on Stanford2D3D [ 2 ] and Metropolis [ 26 ] , which are purely indoor and outdoor. For DAP, we input an ERP image, obtain its ERP depth, and convert it to CP depth. For MoGe2, we input CP images and get CP depth. Then evaluations are performed in the CP space in a face-wise manner. As shown in Table 2 , DAP performs better than MoGe2 on Stanford2D3D, whereas MoGe2 is more competitive on Metropolis. These observations motivate us to combine both panorama and perspective teachers for more effective distillation.

blocks.en: Previous works have shown that perceiving the global context is important for depth estimation [ 57 , 27 ] . Also, our ZipDepth baseline already implements several modules to enhance global perception. However, due to the distortion and left-right discontinuity in ERP images, its global modeling is insufficient, so we design a Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF) module to further enhance its contextual modeling capabilities. As shown in Fig. 3 , it consists of a spherical cross-level attention module and a panorama local feed-forward network.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作表明,了解全球背景对于深度估计十分重要[57、27]。 另外,我们的Zip Depth基线已经实施了若干单元,以提高全球认识。 然而,由于ERP图像的扭曲和左侧不连续,其全球建模不足,因此我们设计了一个球形跨层地物融合(SCFF)模块来进一步提高其上下文建模能力. 如图3所显示,它包括一个球形的跨级别关注模块和一个全景本地的向导网络.

blocks.en: We initialize the base student from the released ZipDepth checkpoint and train each of our configurations independently for 100,000 iterations at 512 × 1024 512\times 1024 ERP resolution using the PyTorch [ 29 ] framework on an RTX 2080 Ti. We use AdamW [ 24 ] with weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , gradient-norm clipping at 1.000, and AMP FP16. We also use a OneCycle [ 35 ] learning schedule with a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a 1% warm-up fraction, and linear annealing. Unless stated otherwise, in each iteration we use a batch size of 8 for labeled data and 8 for unlabeled data when using distillation. We use the checkpoint from the last step to evaluate for fairness. Augmentation includes horizontal flips, color jitter, random yaw and pitch rotations, and polar RGB masking, following DA360 [ 18 ] .

blocks.en: For UniFuse, BiFuse++, and ACDNet, we retrain them using ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 encoders. For DA360-S, the ViT-Small version, we finetune its released checkpoint. These four models are retrained on our labeled data for fairness. For DAP, DepthMaster, and PaGeR, we directly use released weights. Efficiency is measured on Jetson Orin NX 16GB (MAXN, PyTorch eager, AMP FP16, batch size one, native input resolutions). Latency averages 300 forward passes after warm-up, excluding I/O and CPU preprocessing. Attention uses native PyTorch Scaled Dot-Product Attention (SDPA) with external xFormers [ 19 ] and flashAttn [ 10 , 11 ] disabled for fairness and pytorch-native. Our model uses reparameterization [ 12 ] . DepthMaster and PaGeR did not complete this formal run due to OOM.

Table 3 compares depth accuracy and inference cost, with latency measured on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode. Compared with UniFuse, EG360 reduces AbsRel by 26.245%, 39.432%, and 20.297% on Matterport3D, Stanford2D3D, and Metropolis, respectively, and also improves δ 1 \delta_{1} on all three datasets.
With only 6.593M parameters and 23.492 GFLOPs, EG360 is also more efficient than previous lightweight models.
Compared to DA360-S, EG360 achieves similar results on Matterport3D and Metropolis while running 18 times faster. DAP and PaGeR can achieve better results, but they require 2543.697 and 26200.188 GFLOPs of computation. As for DepthMaster, it achieves the lowest indoor AbsRel, but its high Metropolis error may be related to the absence of outdoor panoramas in training.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 4 : Overall ablation of APPD and SCFF on three real-world test datasets. EG360 includes both components. Bold denotes the best value in each column.
blocks.zh: 表4: APPD和SCFF在三个现实世界测试数据集上的总体缩写. EG360包含两个组件. 粗体表示每栏中的最佳值.

blocks.en: Table 4 report the overall ablation study for APPD and SCFF. APPD alone reduces AbsRel from 0.199 to 0.169 on Matterport3D, from 0.126 to 0.101 on Stanford2D3D, and from 0.266 to 0.244 on Metropolis. SCFF alone also improves all six metrics over the baseline without using pseudo labels. Combining the two components yields EG360, which achieves the best overall results among test datasets. Especially, SCFF is more effective on Stanford2D3D, as it’s intended for global semantic enhancement, which could be more useful for indoor scenarios. In terms of efficiency, APPD leaves the inference architecture unchanged at 6.144M parameters and 21.196 GFLOPs while SCFF adds 0.449M parameters, 2.296 GFLOPs.
blocks.zh: 表4汇报了APPD和SCFF的总体扩展研究。 仅APPD就将AbsRel在Matterport3D上的从0.199减少到了0.169,从斯坦福2D3D上的从0.126减少到了0.101,从大都会的从0.266减少到了0.244. 单是SCFF还可以在不使用伪标签的情况下改进基线上的所有6个度量. 将两个组件组合起来产生EG360,这在测试数据集中取得了最佳的总体结果. 特别是,SCFF在斯坦福2D3D上更有效,因为它的用意是全球语义增强,这对室内情景可能更有用. 在效率方面,APPD将推论架构留在了6.144M参数和21.196GFLOP,而SCFF则增加了0.449M参数,2.296GFLOP.

blocks.en: As discussed in Table 2 , DAP and MoGe2 are complementary in terms of performance on different domains. Here, as listed in Table 5 , simply averaging the losses from the two teachers yields more balanced results than using them alone. For example, on Matterport3D, simple averaging yields an AbsRel of 0.168 while using them alone leads to 0.176.

blocks.en: In Table 6 , we vary the unlabeled batch size from 1 to 16 under average distillation. Increasing it from 1 to 8 reduces Matterport3D AbsRel from 0.184 to 0.168 and Stanford2D3D AbsRel from 0.115 to 0.109. A batch size of 16 gives similar results against a batch size of 8 but would leads to more computation during training. Thus, we use 8 as the unlabeled batch size across our other experiments.

It also attains the highest Matterport3D δ 1 \delta_{1} . That is, APPD offers a useful accuracy trade-off across various domains.

blocks.zh: 表8:Avg教师聚变下的Pseudo-label损失类型。

blocks.en: Table 8 compares three losses for pseudo labels while keeping both teachers fixed. SI normalizes each map by its dispersion as in DA360 [ 18 ] , while LSS fits a scale by least squares before computing the L1 residual. L1 achieves the best result on five of the six metrics. We can see that with SI or LSS, the model would perform much worse on either indoor or outdoor datasets. This indicates that the training cannot recover the actual scale correctly, as these two losses are scale-invariant. Thus, we use L1 loss for unlabeled data.
blocks.zh: 表8比较了假标签的三项损失,同时将两名教师固定下来。 SI通过散射来使每张地图正常化,如DA360 [18] 中,而LSS在计算L1残基之前以最小平方相匹配. L1在6个度量衡中的5个实现最佳成绩. 我们可以看到,在SI或LSS中,模型在室内或室外数据集上的表现会更差. 这表明训练无法正确恢复实际的分级,因为这两种损失是分级变化性的. 因此,我们将L1损失用于无标签的数据.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Limitations and future work. Although EG360 can achieve competitive results, we only used limited unlabeled data, and scaling the unlabeled data may further enhance performance [ 51 , 41 ] . Additionally, as a single-frame model, it suffers from temporal incoherence. Extending EG360 to panoramic video depth estimation [ 36 , 8 ] via cross-frame fusions may reduce depth-flickering effects.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 虽然EG360可以取得竞争性的结果,但我们只使用了有限的无标签数据,而无标签数据的缩放可能会进一步提高性能[51,41]. 此外,作为一个单一框架模式,它存在时间上的不一致。 将EG360扩展至全景视频深度估计[36,8],通过跨帧聚变可以降低深度闪烁效应.
